scripts.dev: dotnet build apps/api/DevPath.slnx && npm run dev -w apps/desktop
scripts.check: npm run check:api && npm run check:desktop
scripts.check:api: dotnet build apps/api/DevPath.slnx && dotnet test apps/api/DevPath.slnx
scripts.check:desktop: npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop && npm run lint -w apps/desktop && npm run test -w apps/desktop && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.publish:api: dotnet publish apps/api/DevPath.Api -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:DebugType=None -o apps/api/publish
scripts.package: npm run publish:api && npm run package -w apps/desktop
